questionnaire.name: SmartUrbanity - Motorcycle and scooter – Safety and comfort

welcome_page.title: Motorcycle and scooter – Safety and comfort
welcome_page.description:
Other drivers, narrow lanes, road surfaces and situations on the road when you ride a motorcycle or scooter.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name, and no public authority receives them.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

Only the SmartUrbanity research team reads your answers. We keep them for research for 36 months; then we delete them or make them anonymous.

  • Motorcycle and scooter – Road safety
  • Motorcycle and scooter – Personal security
  • Motorcycle and scooter – Comfort

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

questionnaire.title: Motorcycle and scooter – Safety and comfort

questions.text: When you ride, how stressful is the way other drivers behave?
questions.help: For example sudden lane changes, driving too close behind you or not giving way.

options.text: Not at all: it doesn't bother me
A little: it bothers me now and then
Moderately: I notice it, but I manage
Very: it often puts me on edge
Extremely: it makes it hard to ride safely

questions.text: How confident are you that you can avoid a crash when a car door opens or a driver doesn't see you?
questions.help: For example a car door opening suddenly, or a driver changing lane or turning without checking.

questions.text: Do parked cars or narrow lanes make it hard for you to ride safely?

options.text: Yes, it's hard to get through
A little: I adjust and manage
No, I get through them with confidence

questions.text: Do speed bumps and similar features make you feel safer when you ride?
questions.help: Features that slow traffic down, such as speed bumps, rumble strips, raised crossings or road markings.

questions.text: When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, do potholes, cobblestones or uneven road surfaces make you feel unsafe?
When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, who on the road makes you feel unsafe? (Select all that apply)
questions.help: Think of specific behaviour, such as passing too close or not giving way, rather than everyone in a group.

questions.text: When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, which of these situations make you feel unsafe? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Unsafe behaviour from drivers, riders or pedestrians
Lack of safe or adequate roads, junctions, signs or lighting

questions.text: After dark, does poor street lighting make you change your route or the time you ride?

During the day, do you ever feel unsafe from crime or harassment when you ride a motorcycle or scooter? (Harassment includes unwanted comments, following, touching, or intimidating behaviour directed at you.)
In the evening or after dark, do you ever feel unsafe from crime or harassment when you ride a motorcycle or scooter?
When you feel unsafe in the evening, what do you change?
questions.help: You can choose more than one answer.

options.text: I share my location with someone
I ask someone to come with me
I use a different means of transport

questions.text: When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, what makes you feel less secure from crime or harassment? (Select all that apply)

options.text: Places with few people around (isolated or deserted areas)
People behaving aggressively or in an intimidating way
Poor maintenance (e.g. abandoned buildings, graffiti, broken infrastructure)
No surveillance or security measures (e.g. no cameras, no staff)
Incidents that happened to me or were reported in the area
Few cues to find my way without sight (e.g. no tactile paths or audio announcements)

questions.text: When you ride a motorcycle or scooter, have you experienced or do you fear harassment because of who you are or how you look (e.g. gender, appearance, origin, age)?
How good is motorcycle parking near the places you go?
questions.help: Think of spaces marked for motorcycles and places where your vehicle is safe from theft.

questions.text: How much do charging points affect whether you use your electric motorcycle or scooter?

options.text: Not for me: my vehicle isn't electric

questions.text: When you are held up on a motorcycle or scooter trip, how stressed do you feel?
questions.help: For example traffic jams, crashes or roadworks.
